constellations.name: Antinous
constellations.history: Antinoiis was a youth of extraordinary beauty, bom in Bithynia, and was the favourite of the Emperor Hadrian. He is said to nave drowned himself in the Nile in the belief that the Emperor’s life would thereby be prolonged, and the constellation was formed in his honour by Hadrian in 132 A.D. Antinoiis has also been associated with Ganymedes who was seized by an eagle and tarried off to be cup- bearer to Jupiter, but this legend belongs more probably to Aquarius.
constellations.influence: No astrological influence was suggested for this constellation by the ancients, but it seems to have been associated with the ideas of passion, love and friendship, for certain of its components stars were named Alkhalimain or A 1 Halilain, the Two Friends, by the Arabs, and the Kabalists associated it with the Hebrew letter Vau and the 6th Tarot Trump " The Lovers.” It has also been said to give a love of swimming, and to be connected with certain sex irregularities, the latter probably being greatest in ' that part of the constellation lying in Capri- corn. Note. Antinoiis lies just south of Altair in Aquila and is now taken as part of that constellation. He is sometimes represented as canying a bow and arrow as he is borne aloft in the Eagle's talons.

constellations.name: Antua
constellations.description: Pnf, umatica, The Air Pump, T^o —
constellations.history: This constellation was added by La Caillc, 1752 A.D., under the name JIachina Pneumatica.
constellations.influence: It is said to bestow prosperity, har- mony and spiritual force.

constellations.name: Apus The Bird of Paradise
constellations.history: This constellation was added by Bayer, 1604 A.D., under the name Apis Indica.
constellations.influence: It is said to confer a kind, benevolent, sympathetic and ambitious nature. This part of the sky has apparently always been associated until birds, for it was known to the Chinese under the names " The Curious Sparrow " and " The Little Wonder Bird." The connection of Gemini-Sagittarius with flight may possibly be due to this constellation.

constellations.name: Aquarius
constellations.legend: Aquarius is said to represent Ganymedes. son of CallirhoS, the most beautiful of mortals, who was carried to heaven by an eagle to act as cup- bearer to Jupiter. According to other accounts, however, it is Deucalion, son of Prometheus, who was translated to heaven in memory of the mighty deluge from which only he and Pyrrha were saved.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy-makes the following observa- tions : "The stars in the shoulders of Aquarius operate like Saturn and Mercury those in the left hand and in the face do the same : those in the thighs have an influence more consonant with that of Mercury, and in a less degree with that of Saturn : those in the stream of water have power similar to that of Saturn, and moderately to that of Jupiter." By the Kabalists Aquarius is associated with the Hebrew letter Nun and the 14th Tarot Trump " Temperance,” over which virtue the constellation appears to have some rule. The beauty of Ganymcdes and his flight through the air also link it to the ideas of personal charm and aviation with which it is certain- ly connected.

constellations.name: Aquila
constellations.legend: Originally called Vultur Volans or the Flying Grype, Aquila represents the Eagle, thought to be Jupiter himself, that earned Ganymedes to heaven (see Aquarius).
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the influence of Aquila is similar to that of Mars and Jupiter. It is said to give great imagination, strong passions, in- domitable will, a dominating character, influence over others, clairvoyance, a keen penetrating mind and ability for chemical research. It has always been associated with the sign Scorpio, and by the Kabalists with the Hebrew letter Vau and the 6th Tarot Trump ” The Lovers.”

constellations.name: Asa
constellations.legend: During the war between the Gods and Titans, the Gods leagued themselves together and swore to withstand their enemies, confirming their oath upon an altar built for them by the Cyclops. After their victory' the altar was taken up to heaven to commemorate the good resulting from unity, According to another account Ara was the altar on which the Centaur offered his sacrifices.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy its influence is similar to that of Venus and also Mercury in some degree. It is said to give aptness in science, egoism, devotion and a love of ecclesiastical matters 8 Argo Navis. The Ship Argo. £510—^20. 15S-65S.

constellations.name: Aries
constellations.legend: Aries represents the ram with the golden fleece, a gift from Mercury, upon which Phrixus and his sister Helle escaped through the air from their step-mother Ino. On arriving in Colchis, Phrixus sacrificed the ram to Jupiter and its fleece was hung in the Grove of Mars, whence it was subsequently carried away by Jason [see Argo). According to another account it was the ram that guided Bacchus to a spring of water in the Libyan desert.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy's observations are as follows : *' The stars in the head of Aries possess an influence similar in its effects to that of Mars and Saturn : those in the mouth act similarly to Mercury, and in some degree to Saturn ; those in the hinder foot, to Mars ; those in the tail, to Venus.” By the Kabalists Aries is associated with the Hebrew letter and the 5th Tarot Trump " The Pope.”

constellations.name: Bootes
constellations.legend: Bootes is said to be Areas, whose mother Callisto was transformed into a bear (see Ursa Major) by Juno. While hunting. Areas came upon his mother unawares in her form of a bear and pur- sued her into the temple of Jupiter, where he would have killed her and afterwards been killed himself by the priests. In order to prevent this, Jupiter, who had taken pity on them, took them both into heaven, where Bootes is still seen pursuing the Bear. According to another account Bootes is Icarius, who was killed by some shepherds he had made drunk with a flagon of wine given him by Bacchus. In -consideration of the grief of his daughter Erigone and their hound Msra, Jupiter placed her father in heaven as Bootes, together with herself as Virgo and the hound as Canis Minor.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the influence of the constellation is like that of Mercury and Saturn, though the star Arcturus is like Mars and Jupiter. It is said to give prosperity from work, strong desires, a tendency to excess, and fondness for rural pursuits, together with some liking for occultism. The Kabalists associate it with the Hebrew letter Teth and the 9th Tarot Trump " The Hermit."

constellations.name: Cxum
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille, 1752, from stars between Columba and Eridanus. It is sometimes called Caila Sculpt oris, the Sculptor's Tools, and Scalp tori um.
constellations.influence: It has been said to give artistic tiste and inclination, religious feeling, and fondness for astronomy, architecture and engraving.

constellations.name: Camelopardalis
constellations.legend: This constellation represents the crab that bit the heel of Hercules during his fight with the Lemean Hydra, and was placed amongst the stars in gratitude by Juno, the enemy of Hercules.
constellations.history: This constellation was formed by Baxt- schius in 1614 to represent the camel that brought Rebecca to Isaac.
constellations.influence: It is said to confer patience, endurance, . and great wisdom, and to cause its natives to become teachers or instructors of some kind. 14 Cancer. The Crab. 2522 — ft 17. sN — 40N.

constellations.name: Canes Vekatici
constellations.history: Formed by Hevelius in 1690. Tlicy are represen t«l by two greyhounds. the northern one named Astcrion, and the southern Chara, held in leash by BoStes and assisting in his pursuit of the Bear.
constellations.influence: This constellation gives a love of hunting and a penetrating mind, making those bom under it faithful, keen, clever and fond of specula- tion-

constellations.name: Canis Major
constellations.legend: This constellation is said to represent the dog set by Jupiter to guard Europa whom he had stolen and conveyed to Crete. According to other accounts, however, it was cither L relaps, the hound of Actreon ; that of Diana's nymph Procris ; that given by Aurora to Cephalus ; or finally one of the dogs of Orion.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy states that the stars of this constellation, with the exception of Sirius, are like Venus. It is said to give good qualities, chanty and a faithful heart, but violent and dangerous passions. There is some danger from, or fear of, darkness and the night, and liability to dog bites, though the latter characteristic is probably to be associated more particularly with Sirius. Canis Major is connected by the Kabalists with the He- brew letter Tzaddi and the iSth Tarot Trump " The Moon.”

constellations.name: Canis Minor
constellations.legend: Canis Minor represents Micra, the hound of Icarius, who drowned himself on account of his grief at the death of his master {see Bootes). According to another account it was Helen's dog who was lost in the Euripus.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy gives no information as to the influence of the constellation itself, but merely dcs- scribes that of its chief star, Procyon. By other authors, however, it is said to cause frivolity and either love of dogs or danger of dog-bites. It is noteworthy that the ideas of water and drowning seem to be universally associated with this con- stellation, for in addition to the Greek ideas embodied in the legends its Euphratcan name was the Water- Dog, and its Chinese equivalent Nan Ho, the South- ern River, certain of the stars being called Shwuy Wei, a Place of Water. Together with Canis Major this constellation is associated by the Kabalists with the Hebrew letter Tzaddi and the 28th Tarot Trump " The Moon.”

constellations.name: Cassiopeia
constellations.legend: Cassiopeia, the the wife of Ceplieus and mother of Andromeda, was taken into heaven in consideration of the deeds of Perseus ( see Andro- meda). She is said to have boasted that not only Andromeda but she herself was fairer than the Nereids, and for that reason she was bound to her chair and condemned to circle the pole head down- wards as a lesson in humility.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy this constella- tion is of the nature of Saturn and Venus. It is said to give haughtiness, boastfulness and exaggerated pride, but at the same time the power of commanding respect It is associated by the Kabalists with the Hebrew letter Beth and the 2nd Tarot Trump " The High Priestess."

constellations.name: Centaurus
constellations.legend: This constellation probably represents Pholos, son of Silenus and Melia, who was accident- ally wounded in the foot by one of Hercules' poi- soned arrows. According to some accounts it is Chiron, but he is more correctly associated with Sagittarius.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the stars in the human part of the figure are of the nature of Venus and Mercury, and the*bright stars in the horse's part of Venus and Jupiter. It is said to give hard- heartedness, inclination to vengeance, love of arms, strong passions and an energetic nature. It may also be connected with poison.

constellations.name: Cepiieus
constellations.legend: Cepheus, King of ^Ethiopia, was taken into heaven with his wife Cassiopeia and daughter Andromeda in commemoration of the deeds of Perseus ( see Andromeda).
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy, Cepheus is like Saturn and Jupiter. It gives authority and a sober mind, sometimes making its natives judges or arbi- trators, but exposes to cruel and severe trials. If Mars afflicts the luminaries from Cepheus, especially if in an angle, it causes death by hanging, decapita- tion, crucifixion or impalement. By the Kaba lists this constellation is associated with the Hebrew letter Shin and the 22nd Tarot Trump “ The Fool."

constellations.name: Cerberus
constellations.legend: This constellation, which is not now recognised, was probably added by Hevelius in 1690. It represents the three-headed monster that guarded the gates of Hades and was brought to the upper world by Hercules. The figure depicts it as held by Hercules, in which constellation it is now merged. According to some accounts it is the serpent slain by Hero that infested the country around Tainarum.
constellations.history: and
constellations.influence: Cerberus is said to cause faithfulness, devotion, industry and watchfulness, and to restrain from evil, but to give danger of poison.

constellations.name: Cirrus
constellations.description: The Whale or Sea Monster, X 1 7 —
constellations.legend: Cctns represents the sea monster sent by Neptune to devour Andromeda ( see Andromeda).
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy this constella- tion is like Saturn. It is said to cause laziness and idleness, but to confer an emotional and charitable nature, with ability to command.

constellations.name: ClIAMXLEON
constellations.history: Added by Bayer in 1604.
constellations.influence: Chamaeleon is said to give a practical and sound mind with a love of knowledge, a sym- pathetic and adaptable nature, and fondness for travel and the drama.

constellations.name: Circinus
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille in 1752.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a revengeful, violent, grasping and tenacious nature. 26 Columba NOiE.' Noah’s Dove. 115 — 55 17. 27S— 43S.

constellations.name: Coma Berenices
constellations.legend: Added by Eratosthenes in a.d. 300. Berenice, the wife of Ptolemy Euergetes, offered up her hair to Venus on condition that her husband returned safe from the wars. The hair was placed in the temple but was stolen, and to appease the king's wrath it was said that Venus had taken it into heaven to form a constellation.
constellations.history: and
constellations.influence: It is said to give a suave and well-bred manner, with great personal charm, but to lead to an idle and dissipated life. There is some love of, or ability for the stage. Lilly states that the beginning of this constellation causes blindness or defective eyesight, and it is probable that the part lying in Virgo has some influence over baldness.

constellations.name: Capricornus
constellations.legend: During their war with the giants, the Gods were driven into Egypt and pursued by Typhon. In order to escape, each was forced to change his shape, and Pan, leaping into the Nile, turned the wppy; ’part. tL -a 'gvjS. -ani Vnt Vower part into a fish, a shape considered by Jupiter worthy of commemoration in the heavens.
constellations.influence: ^Ptolemy’s observations are as follows : ** The stars in the horns of Capricorn have efficacy similar to that of Venus, and partly to that of Mars. The stars in the mouth are like Saturn, and partly like Venus : those in the feet and in the belly .act in the same manner as Mars and Mercury : those in the tail are like Saturn and Jupiter." By the Kabalists this constellation is associated with the Hebrew letter Yod and the ioth Tarot Trump "The Wheel of Fortune.”

constellations.name: Corona Borealis
constellations.legend: Corona Borealis represents the garland . given by Venus to Ariadne on the occasion of her marriage to Bacchus after she had been forsaken by Theseus.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy it is like Venus and Mercury. It is said to give artistic ability, love of flowers, lassitude and disillusionment, but to bring its natives to a position of command. By the Kabalists it is associated with the Hebrew letter Daleth and the 4th Tarot Trump "The Emperor."

constellations.name: Auriga
constellations.legend: Auriga represents Erichthonius, son of Vulcan and King of Athens, who was the first to devise a chariot, drawn by four horses, which he used in order to conceal his greatly deformed feet. The goat and kids depicted in the constellation figure commemorate the goat upon whose milk Jupiter was reared, together with her offspring.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the bright stars are like Mars and Mercury. The constellation is said to give self-confidence, interest in social and educational problems, and happiness, but danger of great vicissitudes. The native is fond of country life and may be a teacher or have the upbringing of young people. By the Kabalists Auriga is associ- ated with the Hebrew letter Saraech and the 15th Tarot Trump " The Devil."

constellations.name: Crater
constellations.legend: This constellation represents the cup given by Apollo to the crow (see Corvus).
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy it is like Venus and in some degree like Mercury. It gives a kind, -generous, cheerful, receptive, passionate and hospi- table nature, with good mental abilities, but subject to apprehension and indecision. There is a disor- dered life full of sudden and unexpected events, and great danger of unhappiness, but usually some eminence.

constellations.name: Crux
constellations.history: Usually atributed to Royer, 1679, but much older.
constellations.influence: Crux is said to give perseverance, but many burdens, trials and responsibilities, together with much suffering and many hardships. Note .— In connection with the rulership of coun- tries it may be noted that Brazil was named the Land ol tivs. Kobj Grass, by *&£ fevrerti G&Wi m isfr May, 1500, and that the constellation Crux has been represented on the postage stamps of that country. 42 ‘ '

constellations.name: Custos Messidii
constellations.legend: In order to visit Leda, the wife of Tyn- dareus, King of Sparta, with whom he was in love, Jupiter turned himself into a swan and being pursued by Venus in the shape of an eagle flew to Leda as if for protection. / nflutnce. Cygnus gives a contemplative, dreamy, cultured and adaptable nature. The affections are ill-regulated and unsteady, and the talents develop late. There is some love of water and swimming and the arts. By the Kabalists it is associated with the Hebrew letter Resh and the zoth Tarot Trump ** Judgment.” 35- Delphinus. The Dolphin. 1=8— =19. 3N — 19N.
constellations.history: Formed by La Lande in 1773 under the title Le Messier, but not now recognised. It lies near Cassiopeia and Cephe’us.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a simple, kind, re- tiring, pleasant and honest nature with interest in rural pursuits. 34 - Cygnus. The Swan. >5 z$—K 28. 28N— 55N.

constellations.name: Draco
constellations.legend: Draco represents the dragon that guarded the golden apples in the garden of the Hesperides. According to other accounts, however, it is either the dragon thrown by the giants at Minerva in their war with the Gods, or the serpent Python slain by Apollo after the deluge.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the bright stars are like Saturn and Mars. Draco gives an artistic and emotional but sombre nature, a penetrating and analytical mind, much travel and many friends but danger of robbery and of accidental poisoning. It was said by the Ancients that when a comet was here* ijnisno. was. scattered, oxer the. 'iwJ/i. Kabalists it is associated with the Hebrew letter Mem and the 13th Tarot Trump ** Death."

constellations.name: Equuleus
constellations.legend: According to various accounts Equuleus represents CeJeris, the brother of Pegasus ; or Cyl- larus, the horse of Pollux.
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille in 1752 and usually known by the name Pictor.
constellations.influence: It gives friendship and sagacity but frivolity and love of pleasure. 39< Equttlecs Pictoris. The Painter’s Easel. Do— ^5. 45S-65S.

constellations.name: E rid anus
constellations.legend: Eridanus represents the river Padus or Po into which Pliaton fell when slain by Jupiter for avwg set the w orld on fire by misguiding the chariot of his father Phcebus.
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille, 1752.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy all the stars with the exception of Achernar are like Saturn, ridanus gives a love of knowledge and science, much vel and many changes, a position of authority, ut danger of accidents, especially at sea, and of drowning. 4I - Feus - Tt = Cat. aaS— 1515. 15S— 2jS • obsolete 0 ’' Fonned by La ™ lSo 5’ but no ’ v

constellations.name: Frederici Honores
constellations.history: An obsolete constellation formed by Bode in 1787, in honour of Frederick II of Prussia, from stars between Cepheus, Andromeda, Cassiopeia and Cygnus.
constellations.influence: The constellation figure contains a nimbus to represent dignity, a laurel for fame, an olive branch for peace, and a sword and pen for war and literature. It is possible that some influence over these qualities may be inherent in the con- stellation.

constellations.name: Gemini The Twins
constellations.legend: The constellation represents Castor and Pollux, the twin sons of Leda and Jupiter. It has a'lso ‘been suggested that it may represent Apollo and Hercules.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy makes the following observa- tions : The stars in the feet of Gemini have an influence similar to that of Mercury, and moderately to that of Venus. The bright stars in the thighs are like Saturn." It is said to cause trouble and disgrace, sickness, loss of fortune, affliction and danger to the faiees. By the Kabalists it is associated with the Hebrew letter Qoph and the igth Tarot Trump The Sun."

constellations.name: Globus Aerostaticus
constellations.history: Formed by La Lande in 1798, but now obsolete.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a dreamy, poetical, talkative, boastful, fickle and changeable nature. The sign Aquarius containing this constellation has always been associated with aeronautics probably on this account.

constellations.name: Grus
constellations.legend: This constellation was put in heaven as a reminder of the labours of Hercules. According to another account, however, during the war between the Gods and Titans the former all ran to one side oi the heavens, which would have fallen had not Atlas and Hercules supported it, and the latter was placed in the sky in commemoration of this service.
constellations.history: Added by Bayer, 1604.
constellations.influence: Grus gives a retiring, active, proud, watchful, kind, idealistic and devoted nature, with a liking for astronomy. 47- Hercules. The Kneeling Man. =0=28— V$2. 5N— 53N.

constellations.name: Horolocium Oscillatoiuyjm
constellations.history: Added by La Caille, 1752. It has also been named Horoscope.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a steady, patient and industrious nature, a well-stored mind and a fond- ness for history.

constellations.name: Hydra
constellations.legend: This constellation represents the snake picked up and taken to Apollo by the crow (see Corvus).
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the bright stars are like Saturn and Venus. It is said to give an emotional and passionate nature, threatened by great troubles, and to cause some interest in shipping.

constellations.name: Hydros
constellations.history: Added by Bayer, 1604.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a cunning, practical and treacherous nature, with great danger of poisoning.

constellations.name: Indus
constellations.history: Formed by Bayer, 1604.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a quick penetrating mind, deep insight, and interest in orientalism, mysticism and sport.

constellations.name: Lacerta
constellations.history: ' Formed by Hevelius, 1690. The Sceptre and Hand of Justice, introduced by Royer in i 679 > occupied the same place, but was superseded by Lacerta.
constellations.influence: It gives a keen, practical intellect, a careful, patient and scientific nature, and a great love of power and justice.

constellations.name: Leo
constellations.legend: This constellation represents the Nemean Lion, originally from the Moon, that was slain by Hercules.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy makes the following obser- vations : *' Of the stars in Leo, two in the head are like Saturn and partly like Mars. The three in the neck are like Saturn, and in some degree like Mercury. . . . Those in the loins . . . Saturn and Venus : those in the thighs resemble Venus, and, in some degree. Mercury.” It is said that the stars in the .neck, back and wing all bring trouble, disgrace and sickness affecting the part of the body ruled by the sign, especially if they happen to be in conjunction with the .Moon, By the Kabalists, Leo is associated with the Hebrew letter Kaph and the nth Tarot Trump *' Strength."

constellations.name: Leo Minor
constellations.history: Formed by Hevelius, 1690.
constellations.influence: It gives a generous, noble, peaceable, but fearless nature, with the ability to undertake prominent and responsible positions.

constellations.name: Lepus
constellations.legend: A young man of the Isle of Leros greatly desired a hare and brought some over, for none were to be found on the island. The other in- habitants also wished to keep hares, but eventually the animals multiplied to such an extent that there was not enough food for them and they devoured the com in the fields, whereupon the inhabitants joined together and destroyed them all.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy, Lepus is like Saturn and Mercury. It gives a quick wit, timidity, circumspection, fecundity and defiance.

constellations.name: Libra
constellations.legend: Libra was not considered a separate constellation by the ancients and was called Chela, or the Claws of Scorpio, which sign was made to consist of 6o°. The present constellation figure is said to represent the balance wherein Astra»a weighed the deeds of men and presented them to Jupiter. Infi.ue#c& Ptolemy makes tie folio tving ohsarea- tions : " Those stars at the points of the claws of Scorpio operate like Jupiter and Mercury: those in the middle of the daws, like Saturn, and m some degree like Mars.” By the Kabalists, Libra is associated with the Hebrew letter Heth and the Sth Tarot Trump " Justice.

constellations.name: Lotos
constellations.legend: The wolf is said to be placed in the heavens as a reminder of the religious nature of Chiron the Centaur, who is depicted as spearing it in order to offer it as a sacrifice.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the bright stars are like Saturn and partly like Mars. Lupus is sai to give an acquisitive, grasping, aggressive, pruden and treacherous nature, with a keen desire for know- ledge, and strong ill-regulated passions.

constellations.name: Lynx
constellations.legend: Mercury found the body of a tortoise cast up by the Nile, and discovered that by striking the sinews after the flesh was consumed a musical note was obtained. He made a lyre of similar shape, having three strings, and gave it to Orpheus, riie son of Calliope, who by its music enchanted the beasts* birds and rocks. After Orpheus was slain by the Thracian women, Jupiter placed the lyre in heaven at the request of Apollo and the Muses. This constellation was often called Vultur Cadens, or the Falling Grype by the ancients.
constellations.history: Added by Hevelius. 1690. and sometimes called Tigris, the Tiger. . ,
constellations.influence: It is said to give stealthiness ana cunning, many changes iD life, and an adventurous 59 Lyra: The Lyre. >110—1129- 28N— 47 N -

constellations.name: Machina Electrica
constellations.history: An obsolete constellation formed by Bode in 1800.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a scientific spirit, a mind in advance of its time and peculiar or idealistic view’s.

constellations.name: MiCROSCOPIUM
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille, 1752.
constellations.influence: It gives a careful, methodical, fas- tidious, meticulous and scientific nature.

constellations.name: Monoceros
constellations.history: Added by Bartschius, 1624.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a pioneering, per- sistent, enterprising, ambitious and pushing nature with a love of travel and change.

constellations.name: Mons MeKSLS
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille, 1752. and now generally known by the name Mensa.
constellations.influence: It gives an ambitious, aspiring and proud nature. There will be many difficulties in the life, but they will eventually be overcome and the latter years will be peaceful.

constellations.name: Musca Australis
constellations.history: Formed by Bayer, 1604.
constellations.influence: It gives a capricious, fickle, pleasure- loving, changeable, but industrious nature.

constellations.name: Musca Borealis
constellations.history: Added by Bartschius, 1624.
constellations.influence: It gives a practical, pleasure-loving, changeable and industrious nature, together with sarcasm and spitefulness. There is a good deal of vitality and favourable financial prospects.

constellations.name: Noctoa
constellations.history: An obsolete constellation that super- seded Solitarius, the Solitaire, or Turdus Solitarius, the Solitary Thrush, formed by Le Monnier in 1776. It occupies the end of the tail of Hydra.
constellations.influence: It is said to give wisdom, discrimina- tion, penetration, patience, and depth of thought and study.

constellations.name: Norma et Regula
constellations.history: Added by La Caille, 1753. Sometimes called Quadra Euclidis, Euclid's Square, but now generally known as Norma.
constellations.influence: It is said to give honesty, truthfulness, justice and an upright life, with interest in Free- masonry, geometry, surveying, mathematics and architecture.

constellations.name: Nubecula Major
constellations.history: Probably added by Bayer, 1604.
constellations.influence: It gives a poetical, artistic and imagi- native nature but much hard work and powers of persistence.

constellations.name: Nubecula Minor
constellations.history: Probably added by Bayer, 1604.
constellations.influence: Similar to that of Nubecula Major but gives isolation and loneliness.

constellations.name: Octans Hadleianus
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille in 1752 in recogni- tion of the octant invented in 1730 by John Hadley. It is now usually abbreviated to Octans.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a scientific mind marred by ill-regulated passions, psychic distur- bances and discord.

constellations.name: Officina TYPOGRArniCA
constellations.history: Formed by Bode in 1800, but now ob- solete. , • -^i
constellations.influence: It is said to give a keen and ongmai mind, and honour through literature and art.

constellations.name: Opihuciius or Serpentarius
constellations.legend: This constellation is said to represent the infant Hercules who strangled two serpents sent y Juno to kill him as he lay asleep in his cradle {see Serpens). . _
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy it is like Sat and moderately like Venus. It is said to give a passionate, blindly good-hearted, wasteful and eas y seduced nature, together with little happiness, un- seen dangers, enmity, strife and slander. said that it occasioned much .mortality y poisoning. This constellation has also been cauea Aisculapius, and held to rule medicines. By tne Kabalists it is associated with the Hebrew letter m and the 16th Tarot Trump “ The Lightning-Strucic Tower."

constellations.name: Pegasos
constellations.legend: Pegasus was bom from the blood of Medusa after Perseus had cut off her head, and was afterwards tamed and ridden by BeUerophon. Being weary of earthly affairs BeUerophon attempted to fly to heaven but feU off, and Pegasus continued his course, entered heaven and took his place among the stars.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the bright stars are like Mars and Mercury. The constellation gives ambition, vanity, intuition, enthusiasm, caprice and bad judgment.

constellations.name: Perseus
constellations.legend: Perseus, the son of Jupiter and Danae, was furnished with the sword, cap and wings of Mercury and the shield of Minerva. He killed the Medusa by cutting oS her head and afterwards rescued and married Andromeda. On his return home he in- advertently killed his grandfather Acrisius and pined away through grief, whereupon Jupiter took pity on him and placed him among the stars.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy, Perseus is like Jupiter and Saturn. It is said to give an intelligent, strong, bold and adventurous nature but a tendency to lying. By the Kabalists it is associated with the Hebrew letter Lamed and the 12th Tarot Trump “ The Hanged Man."

constellations.name: Phoenix
constellations.history: Added by Bayer in 1604.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a pioneering dis- position, ambition and power, together with a long life and lasting lame.

constellations.name: Pisces
constellations.legend: Venus and her son Cupid while sitting on the bank of the Euphrates suddenly saw Typhon, the enemy of the Gods, approaching them. They leapt into the river and were saved fiom drowning by two fishes; who were afterwards placed in the heavens by Venus in gratitude for their help.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy makes the following obser- vations : " Those stars in Pisces which are in the head of the southern fish have the same influence as Mercury, and, in some degree, as Satum : those in the body are like Jupiter and Mercury : those in the tail and in the southern line are like Satum, and, moderately, like Mercury. In the northern fish, those on its body and backbone resemble Jupiter, and also Venus in some degree : those in the northern line are like Satum and Jupiter.” By the Kabalists Pisces is associated with the Hebrew letter Pe and the 17th Tarot Trump '* The Stars.”

constellations.name: Piscis Australis
constellations.legend: This constellation is said to commemor- ate the transformation of Venus into the shape of a fish on one occasion when bathing. Injhunce. Ptolemy gives no separate influence , , and only describes Fomalhaut, but according to Bayer the constellation is of the nature of Saturn. It is said to have an influence similar to that of Pisces, but, in addition, to augment the fortunes.

constellations.name: Piscis Volans
constellations.history: Added by Bayer, 1604. It is known as Volans.
constellations.influence: It is said to give -a quick mind, activity, emotion, imagination and poetical or artistic ability.

constellations.name: Psalterium Georgianum
constellations.history: Formed by the Abbd Hell in 1781 in honour of George II of England, but now obsolete. It lies between the forefeet of Taurus and Eridanus. In the horoscope of George II the Sun and Venus were conjoined in Scorpio in opposition to this constellation.
constellations.influence: It is said to give an harmonious and artistic nature together with joviality and kind- ness.

constellations.name: Pyxis Nautica
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille in 1752 from stars in the mast of Argo.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a wise, ambitious and steady nature, good judgment and interest in nautical and geographical matters.

constellations.name: Quadrans Muraus
constellations.history: Fonned by La Lande in 1795 but now obsolete.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a scientific mind, rectitude, justice, idealism and penetration.

constellations.name: Reticulum Rhomboidalis
constellations.history: Formed by Habiecht o! Stiassburg.
constellations.influence: It gives a restricted life, self-absorp- tion, tenacity, selfishness and emotion.

constellations.name: Robur Carolinum
constellations.history: Formed by Halley, 1679, in commemora- tion of the oak in which Charles II Jay hidden on 3rd September, 1651.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a frank, honourable, generous, hospitable and steady nature.

constellations.name: Sagitta
constellations.legend: Sagitta represents the arrow with which Hercules slew the eagle that fed upon the liver of Prometheus.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy this constella- tion is like Saturn and moderately like Venus, but Bayer states that it is of the nature of Mars and Venus. It is said to give a keen mind with ability for abstract thought and teaching or writing, irrita- bility, jealousy and danger of hostility and bodily harm. 6 -88. Sagittarius. The Archer. $ 28— ^=r. 20S — 50S.

constellations.name: Sceptrum Brandenburgicum
constellations.history: Added by Gottfried Kirch, 1688.
constellations.influence: It is said to give honour, wealth, eminence and power.

constellations.name: Scorpio
constellations.legend: This constellation represents the \ scorpion that killed Orion ( see Orion).
constellations.influence: Ptolemy makes the following obser- vations : " The bright stars in the front of the body of Scorpio have an effect similar to that produced by the influence of Mars, and partly to that produced by Saturn : the three in the body itself ... arc similar to Mars and moderately to Jupiter: those in the joints of the tail are like Saturn and partly like Venus : those in the sting, like Mercury and Mars." By the Kabalists Scorpio is associated with the Hebrew letter Oin and the 16th Tarot Trump " The Lightning'S truck Tower."

constellations.name: Sculptor
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille in 1752, its full title being Apparatus Sculptoris.
constellations.influence: It is said to give ambition, creative imagination and artistic abilities.

constellations.name: Scutum Sobiescianum
constellations.history: Formed by Hevelius in 1690 in honour of John Sobieski III King of Poland.
constellations.influence: It is said to give eminence, honour, power, and bravery together with an adventurous career.

constellations.name: Serpens
constellations.legend: When Glaucus, son of Minos, King of Crete, was drowned in a barrel of red honey, ^Escula- pius was sent for to restore him to life and was shut in a secret chamber with the body. While he stood wondering what to do a serpent entered, which he slew. Thereupon another serpent came in bearing a herb which it placed on the head oithe dead serpent, thereby restoring it to life, and Aisculapius, using the same herb, succeeded in restoring Glaucus. The serpent was placed in heaven arid for this reason cer tai n writers have identified ,Ophiuchus with Aisculapiu?. 'According to other accounts the serpent is one of those that would have slain Hercules in his cradle (see Ophiuchos).
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy, Serpens is like Saturn and Mars. It is said to give wisdom, craft, deceit, malice, a feeble will and danger of poison.

constellations.name: Sextans Uranus
constellations.history: Formed by Hevelius in 1690. He stated that he placed the sextant between Leo and Hydra because both constellations were of a fiery nature and formed a commemoration of the destruction of lus instruments when his house in Dantzic was burnt in September, 1679.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a keen, intellectual, orderly and exact mind with interest in mathematics, astronomy and similar subjects.

constellations.name: Tarandus
constellations.history: Formed by Le Monnier in 1776.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a quiet, gentle and re- tiring nature, and an obscure life.

constellations.name: Taurus
constellations.legend: Jupiter, assuming the form of a bulb • mingled with the herd when Europa, with whom he was infatuated, andhermaidens disported themselves on the sea-shore. Encouraged by the tameness of the bull Europa mounted it, whereupon the God rushed into the sea and bore her away to Crete. According to other accounts Taurus represents Io whom Jupiter turned into a cow in order to deceive Juno.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy makes the following observa- . tions:" Those stars in Taurus which are in the abscis- sion of the sign resemble In their temperament the influence of Venus, and in some degree tliat of Sa- turn . . . the stars in the head (except Aldebaran) resemble Saturn, and, partly. Mercury ; and those at the top of the horns are like Mars.” By the Kaba- lists Taurus is associated with the Hebrew letter Aleph and the 1st Tarot Trump " The Juggler." In all the ancient Zodiacs, Taurus is the beginning sign and marked the Vernal Equinox from about 4,000 to 1,700 B.C.

constellations.name: Taurus Poniatovii
constellations.history: Formed by the Abbd Poczobut of Wilna in honour of Stanislaus Poniatowski, King of Poland.
constellations.influence: It is Said to give obstinacy and change- ability, emotion, honour and renown.

constellations.name: Telescopium
constellations.history: Formed by La Caille, 1752.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a keen mind, prophet- ic abilities, and interest in philosophical, occult or historical subjects.

constellations.name: Telescopium Herscheui
constellations.history: Formed by the Abb4 Hell in 1781, 13 honour of Sir William Herschel.
constellations.influence: It is said to give scientific abilities, a keen intellect and spiritual powers.

constellations.name: Triangulum
constellations.legend: Triangulum is said to have been piacea in the heavens by Jupiter at the request of Ceres "ho asked that the shape of her island Sicily might be represented amongst the stars.
constellations.history: Formed by Hevelius, 1690.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy itis like Mercury. It is said to give a just, companionable, truthful, righteous and benevolent nature, with interest m architecture and Freemasonry. ior. Triangulum Minor. The Lesser Triangle- 8 6— 8 12- 28N— 33N.

constellations.name: Triangulum Austraie
constellations.history: Attributed to Pieter Theodor of tn x6th century.
constellations.influence: Similar to that of Triangulum.

constellations.name: Tucana
constellations.history: Added by Bayer in 1604.
constellations.influence: It is said to give pride but gentleness, unselfishness, activity and kindness.

constellations.name: Ursa Major
constellations.legend: Callisto, daughter of Lycaon, king of Arcadia, of whom Jupiter was enamoured, became a follower o! Diana on account of her love of hunting. Jupiter sought Callisto by assuming the form of Diana, and Juno who discovered the intrigue turned Callisto into a bear. Angry that the bear was placed in heaven, Juno requested her brother Nep- tune never to let those stars set within his kingdom, and for this reason they are always above the horizon in Europe. To account for the length of the bear’s tail, it is said that Jupiter, fearing her teeth, lifted her by the tail, which became stretched because of her weight and the distance from earth to heaven.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy, Ursa Major is like Mars. It is said to give a quiet, prudent, sus- picious, mistrustful, self-controlled, patient nature, but an uneasy spirit and great anger and revengeful- ness when roused. By the Kabalists it is associated with the Hebrew letter Zain and the 7th Tarot Trump “The Chariot."

constellations.name: Ursa Minor
constellations.legend: According to some accounts this con- stellation represents Areas, son of Callisto and Jupiter (see Bo6tes and Ursa Major). Other writers state that it is meant to represent Cynosura, one of the Nymphs of Crete who reared the infant Jupiter ; the other, Helice, being Ursa Major.
constellations.influence: According to Ptolemy the bright stars are like Saturn and in some degree like Venus, it is said to give indifference and improvidence o spirit, and to lead to many troubles. By the Kaba- lists it is associated with the Hebrew letter Tau an the 2ist Tarot Trump “ The Universe."

constellations.name: Via Lactea
constellations.legend: Via Lactea is said to be caused by an overflow of the milk upon which the infant Mercury was nourished. According to other accounts, how- ever, Saturn, wishing to devour his children, was given a stone by his wife Ops and would have choked had she not poured milk down his throat, some 0 which overflowed and formed the Milky Way.
constellations.influence: It is said to give a sympathetic, hu- mane, artistic, kind and emotional nature. If .Sun or Moon is afflicted here blindness is said fre- quently to ensue.

constellations.name: Virgo
constellations.legend: This constellation is said to represen Erigone, daughter of Icarius, who hanged herse ^ through grief at the death of her father {see BoSrtSj- According to other accounts it is Astrma, d aught of one of the Titans, who sided with the Gods a- gainst her own father.
constellations.influence: Ptolemy makes the following observa- w tions : "The stars in the head of Virgo, and that at the top of the southern wing, operate like Mercury and somewhat like Mars : the other bright stars in the same wing, and those about the girdle, resemble Mercury in their influence, and also Venus, moder- ately . . . those at the points of the feet and at the bottom of the garments aie like Mercury, and also Mars, moderately." By the Kabalists it is asso- ciated with the Hebrew letter Gimel and the 3rd Tarot Trump ** The Empress."

constellations.name: Vulpecula ET Anser
constellations.history: Formed by Hevelius in 1690, and now usually abbreviated to Vulpecula.
constellations.influence: It gives a cunning, voracious and fierce nature, together with a keen mind. THE LUNAJ? MANSIONS In considering the classification of stars into groups, and the influences attaching to these divisions, it is necessary to include the lunar mansions, which are probably much older than either the constellations or the ordinary solar zodiac now in use. These. mansions form a lunar zodiac of 28, or sometimes 27 divisions, each one of which roughly marks the distance travelled by the Moon in one day, and, al- though they undoubtedly underlay all the ancient systems of astrology, and three separate series have come down to us from Arabia, India and China res- 7 pectively, all of which appear to be variants of some * 'single lost system, our knowledge of their several f influences is exceedingly meagre. More details are available of the Arabian system perhaps than of.the others, and in this the influence of each mansion will be found to correspond more or less closely with the Ptolemaic nature of the stars included in it. The method of employing the lunar mansions in practical astrology is not at all properly understood, and it is even doubtful how they should be measured. As given here they are in their original form and refer to groups of stars. lunar_mansions.name: Krittika
lunar_mansions.meaning: The General of the Celestial Armies. Symbol, a Flame or Razor. Regent, Agni. god of fire. Ruled by the Sun. A soft and sharp mansion or asterism belonging to the Brahmin caste and producing mixed effects. Those bom on the lunar day will delight in white flowers, perform sacrifice, and will be magicians, metaphysicians, diggers, barbers, potters, priests or astronomers. With the Moon here at birth the native will be a glutton, adulterous, handsome and famous. Rules forests and the head.

lunar_mansions.name: Rohini
lunar_mansions.meaning: A Red Deer. Symbol, a Temple or Wagon. Regent, Prajapati, the creator. Ruled by the Moon. A stable astensm belonging to the Shudia caste and favourable for coronations, expiatory ceremonies, planting of trees, sowing of seeds, building of towns, and matters of a permanent nature when contain- ing the Moon. Those bom on the lunar day will be devout, rich, merchants, rulers, drivers, possessed of wealth and cattle. With Moon here at birth native will be truthful, polite, steady, handsome, cleanly and uncovetous. Rules vinegar pots and the forehead.

lunar_mansions.name: Mricasiras
lunar_mansions.meaning: The Head of the Stag. Regent, Soma, the Moon. Ruled by Mars. A soft asterism belonging to the serving caste and favourable for friendship, married love, purchase and making of clothes and ornaments, music, and auspicious deeds when containing the Moon. Those bom on the lunar day will deal in perfumes, flowers, ornaments, and animals, will be lascivious and good writers or painters. With Moon here at birth native will be timid, capricious, skilful, talkative, rich, fond of pleasure. Rules cots and the brows.

lunar_mansions.name: Al Dhira

A sharp asterism belonging to the butcher caste and favourable for punishment, torture, imprisonment, exorcism, mesmerism and separation or union when containing the Moon. Those bom on the lunar day will be druggists, dea- lers in flowers and fruit, rich and fond of gardening. With Moon here at biith native will be conceited, wealthy, luxurious, kind-hearted, happy and resolute. Rules

lunar_mansions.name: Al Baldah
lunar_mansions.meaning: The City or District. Favourable for harvest, gain, buildings, and travellers, but causes divorce

lunar_mansions.meaning: ZZ 2° 42'. The Lucky One of the Slaughterers. Helps the escape of servants and captives and the curing of diseases

lunar_mansions.meaning: The Hundred Physician. Regent, Varuna, god- dess of the waters. Ruled by the Dragon’s Head. A mutable asterism belonging to the butcher caste and favourable for commencing work of an imper- manent or moving character. Those bom on the lunar day will be fishermen, washermen, or dealers in wine, fish and birds. With Moon here at birth native will be eloquent, harsh in speech, truthful, adventurous, thoughtless, independent, gambler, fond of bad women, murderer of enemies. Rules streets and the right thigh.

lunar_mansions.name: Uttara Buadra-Pada

A stable asterism belonging to the Kshattriya TELLATIONS caste and favourable for coronations, expiatory ceremonies, planting of trees, sowing of seeds, building of towns, and matters of a permanent nature when containing the Moon. Those bom on the lunar day will be generous, devout, rich, and in influential positions. With Moon here at birth native will be happy, eloquent, charitable, and possess children and grandchildren. .Rules swamps and the knees.

lunar_mansions.name: Al Butain
